text:
Aisha: Quick heads-up — I'm kicking off a 1-hour CRM hygiene sweep at 17:00 UTC to assign placeholder owners to accounts stuck with null owner so playbooks don't stall. Will tag accounts with owner=CS_AUTO until someone claims them.

Marco: Any chance this will retrigger onboarding playbooks? We had a loop last quarter.

Aisha: Good call. I added a gating flag to avoid retriggering. The sweep only updates owner + adds tag `cs:autoclaim` — playbook trigger ignores accounts with `no_retrigger=true` or tag `cs:autoclaim-skip`. Also backing up owner field into `owner_before_autoclaim`.

Leah: Share the query?

Aisha: Here — runbook snippet:
```sql
-- find trial accounts with null owner and last_activity > 7d
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT id FROM accounts
  WHERE owner_id IS NULL
    AND account_stage = 'trial'
    AND last_activity_at < now() - interval '7 days'
    LIMIT 2000
)
UPDATE accounts a
SET owner_id = 'cs_auto_2026',
    metadata = jsonb_set(coalesce(metadata,'{}'), '{owner_before_autoclaim}', to_jsonb(a.owner_id))
FROM candidates c
WHERE a.id = c.id;
```

Marco: Nice. Two questions:
- Who owns the temporary alias (cs_auto_2026)?
- Will this show up on account lists and reports?

Aisha: cs_auto_2026 routes to the rotational queue in Zendesk; we already have TTL of 14 days. Reports will show owner but we also push a telemetry event so dashboards can filter by `autoclaim=true`.

Priya: Can we suppress renewal risk alerts for these accounts while they're in autoclaim? We don't want to pollute the weekly renewal churn report.

Aisha: Yes, adding `autoclaim_hold=true` in telemetry and the renewal-scorer will ignore entries with that flag (we've added logic in scorer v2.1). I'll coordinate with the scoring team.

ops-bot: Job scheduled: crm_hygiene_autoclaim at 2026-03-21T17:00:00Z. ID: job_20260321_17_00

Jake: SRE note — watch DB write QPS during update. Consider batching if we see CPU spikes.

Aisha: Will stream in batches of 200. If the job aborts, it will rollback and send a sig to #customer-success. I'll post a short post-run summary when done.

Leah: Thanks. Can you add a short how-to for claiming an autoclaim account? New hires might be confused.

Aisha: Will add a one-pager in Confluence and ping here when live. :thumbsup:

Priya: Thanks, LGTM.
